• Are you commercially minded and interested in e-commerce and online sales?

• Do you enjoy working with data and turning insights into commercial opportunities?

• Do you want to play an important role in growing HAY’s online footprint?

If yes, please read on!

ONLINE SALES COORDINATOR

Based out of Horsens

At our office facilities by the harbor edge in Horsens, you will become part of an energetic office community, consisting of approx. 100 colleagues looking forward to welcoming you to the team.

About the job

We’re looking for an Online Sales Coordinator to support and develop our online business with key retail partners. You will monitor online sales and product performance, identify commercial opportunities and help ensure that the right products are available and presented in the best possible way across our online sales channels. Working closely with internal teams and online dealers, you will turn data and insights into concrete actions that support sales performance.

More specifically, your tasks will include:

• Monitor online sales and product performance: Follow dealer online sales, stock levels, sell-through and product performance, and identify lost sales, replenishment opportunities and other opportunities to improve online sales

• Optimize product availability and presentation: Ensure key products are available, visible and correctly presented across relevant online sales channels

• Coordinate product information and availability: Coordinate orders, product data, prices, content, digital assets and delivery information, and follow up on availability, replenishment and ETAs

• Support assortment and commercial activities: Provide input on assortment optimization based on product performance and demand, and coordinate online product launches, campaigns and other commercial activities

• Turn data into action: Prepare reports and overviews on online sales, stock and product performance, and turn data and insights from relevant systems and AI tools into actionable recommendations

• Coordinate and collaborate across teams: Work closely with relevant internal teams to align product availability, commercial priorities and online presentation, and ensure structured communication with relevant dealers

• Optimize ways of working: Maintain a structured overview of ongoing activities and contribute to improving processes and workflows within online sales

Are you the Online Sales Coordinator we are looking for?

Role expectations

• As a person, you are outgoing, proactive and a strong communicator

• You are commercially minded and curious, with an interest in understanding what drives online sales

• You are independent, structured and able to keep your focus

• You are solution-oriented and comfortable turning insights into action

• You thrive with both analytical and routine tasks and have an eye for detail

• As our new colleague, you will become part of a community where we cherish our culture and the pace is always high – therefore it is important that you have a desire to be part of the social community that exists across departments, age groups and backgrounds

Experience required

• Ideally, you have experience from a coordinating or commercially oriented role within e-commerce, online sales or wholesale

• You have a good understanding of e-commerce and an interest in online sales and commercial performance

• You are comfortable working with data and using it to identify opportunities

• You are a confident Excel user and comfortable working across different IT systems

• Experience with product data, PIM systems and AI tools is an advantage

• You are fluent in Danish and English, both spoken and written

You want to be a part of HAY?

Then do not hesitate to send us your application and CV (preferably in English) as soon as possible and no later 11 November 2026. We evaluate candidates on an ongoing basis.

If you have any further questions regarding the position, please do not hesitate to contact Senior Manager, Stine Dahl at stine.dahl@hay.com or Recruiter, John Cain at john_cain@hermanmiller.com.

Why join us?

Founded in Copenhagen in 2002 with the ambition of creating contemporary furniture, lighting and accessories for modern living, HAY’s vision is to create high-quality and well-designed products in collaboration with some of the world’s most talented, curious, and courageous designers. Through the commitment to sophisticated industrial manufacturing processes, HAY strives to make good design accessible to the widest possible audience.

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**About The Role

**In this role, you will own and develop our Reward and benefits processes across the company. The scope includes our annual pay review, market benchmarking, benefits and incentive schemes, job architecture, and Rewards activities.

This role would suit a proactive Rewards professional who has previously perhaps worked in a team and is looking for their first stand alone. The expectations on you are to further develop and optimise our recently implemented rewards solutions, in particular in Workday, and support all of the company's rewards processes.

Our company is evolving fast and so an enjoyment of a dynamic and demanding environment with a delivery focus is essential for success.

**What You Will Do

**

• Developing Rewards in Workday to operate efficiently.

• Carrying out benchmarking and updating of pay against the job architecture

• Lead the annual pay-review process across the business.

• Maintaining up to date job architecture with regular reviews to ensure embedded in the organisation

• Develop and maintain our benefit and incentive programmes.

• Compiling required reports and data for pay budgeting, reviewing and equal pay requirements globally

• Continues to ensure that pay and benefits attract the highest calibre of talent available in our markets

**Essential

****What you bring

**

• Three to four years of hands-on experience in reward, compensation, benefits, or a closely related field that includes pay reviews, market benchmarking, benefits, incentive schemes, and job architecture.

• Experience managing reward or benefit activities across different countries, including cross-border pay equity and benefit plans.

• Hands-on experience using Mercer / Mercer Win benchmarking data and tools to compare jobs and pay across different markets.

• Workday experience is a must, particularly configuring job profiles, job architecture and running pay reviews.

• Professional fluency in English.

• undefined undefined

**Your team and key relationships

**You will work closely with HR Directors, HR colleagues, business leaders, and managers across the organisation. Together, you will support a clear understanding of our reward frameworks and help managers make consistent reward decisions.The role also involves maintaining relationships with external reward groups and professional networks.

**What We Offer

**We want you to feel supported, both at work and outside it. Our benefits include:

A 12% employer-paid pension contribution and health insurance.

An annual bonus program

25 days of paid vacation, plus five additional days once you have been with us for nine months

Access to thousands of courses through LinkedIn Learning

Wellbeing initiatives and an annual flu vaccination

Freshly prepared meals from our subsidised on-site canteen

Free parking at our Birkerød site

Social activities through our Employee Association

**Practical Information

**Location: Birkerød, Denmark

Working arrangement: On site

Working language: English / Danish

Employment: Full time

Travel: Up to 5%, possible within Europe

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

SYBO is part of the Miniclip family and known for the widely popular game, Subway Surfers - the most downloaded mobile game in the world, with over four and a half billion downloads. Located in the heart of Copenhagen, we aim to create playful moments that inspire our fans to care.

Hundreds of millions of players play Subway Surfers each month, and enjoy smooth gameplay, new features and a concept that’s now worked for over fourteen (Yes, 14!) years - and we’re looking for a talented Game Engineer to keep the fun going for years to come.

As a Game Engineer on Subway Surfers, you’ll work closely with engineers, designers, artists, and other disciplines to take ideas from concept through implementation and into the hands of the above-mentioned hundreds of millions of players. You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, contribute to technical decisions, and help us continuously improve both the game and the way we build it.

Working with LiveOps lets you get instant feedback on your work - working with one of the largest LiveOps games makes it unique. Read below and get in touch!

**Responsibilities

**

• Develop and maintain gameplay features, systems, and content for Subway Surfers using Unity and C#

• Collaborate with Designers, Artists, and other Engineers to take features from concept through implementation and release

• Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to the long-term health of the Subway Surfers codebase

• Review code and collaborate with other Engineers to share knowledge and maintain engineering quality

• Debug and resolve technical issues across gameplay systems and live features

• Contribute to improving the tools, workflows, and development practices used by the team

Life at SYBO

• In your first month, you’ll get to know SYBO, Subway Surfers, our technology, and how the team works. You’ll work closely with the Technical Owner, Engineers, Designers, and Artists on the game team, familiarize yourself with the codebase and development pipeline, and start contributing to your first features.

• In your first three months, you’ll be contributing independently to features and content and taking an active role in the team’s development process. You’ll participate in technical discussions around implementation, system design, and architecture and become increasingly comfortable working across the Subway Surfers codebase.

• In your first twelve months, you’ll be a trusted and impactful member of the Subway Surfers team, contributing to the development of features and content from planning through release and helping shape technical solutions for the game - and you’ve received plenty of player feedback on things you’ve worked on!

**Requirements

**

• Strong knowledge of OOP languages, primarily C#

• Professional experience developing games, ideally on mobile

• Solid hands-on experience with Unity

• Good understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, algorithms, and common design patterns

• Experience collaborating with multiple disciplines to develop and deliver game features

• Experience working with version control systems such as Git

• Experience working in Agile methodologies

Bonus points

• Experience working on a live game and regularly shipping new features and content

• Experience developing or integrating client/server features and backend services

**About SYBO

**We're SYBO, the mobile games studio behind the legendary Subway Surfers, with over 4.5 billion downloads worldwide! Join our team in the heart of Copenhagen, where creativity flourishes in our new, state-of-the-art studio.

If you join us, you'll have the opportunity to dive into exciting and creative projects alongside a diverse group of like-minded colleagues from over 40 countries across the globe.

We truly believe you perform your best, when you have the equipment you need - and our IT team is always on hand to ensure you have access to the latest tools and gear, enabling you to be at your best - even remotely with a home-office budget!

We also pride ourselves in taking care of your well-being, offering a delicious lunch buffet, a variety of healthy snacks, and regular social events to keep the energy flowing.

SYBO is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants, regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Junior Buyer

Wheat is one of the leading Scandinavian fashion lifestyle brands for children. We are passionate about creating clothing, footwear and accessories that combine timeless design, comfort, and responsible production.

For more than 25 years, we have designed products with great care and attention to detail. Our collections build on a long-standing Danish design tradition, where our most important signatures are high quality and longevity.

We are committed to doing business responsibly — balancing people, planet and profit — and continuously working to reduce our environmental footprint while creating products made to last.

Today, Wheat is powered by an international team of 50+ colleagues with headquarters in our office in Gentofte (Greater Copenhagen), and local offices or showrooms in Munich, Hamburg, Oslo and London.

We believe that diversity of perspectives strengthens creativity, innovation and decision-making — and we strive to build a workplace where everyone feels respected, included and able to contribute.

About the role

Do you have your first years of experience in buying, merchandising or sourcing – and are you ready to take ownership of your own product area at an international children’s wear brand? We are looking for an analytical and commercially minded Junior Buyer to join our Buying & Supply Chain team.

You will be based at our Head Office in Gentofte, report to our Chief Supply Chain Officer and work closely with Design, Sales, Logistics and ESG. You will be responsible for a defined product group and its suppliers, and play an active part in building our collections – from planning, costing and negotiation to orders and delivery.

This is a role with real ownership. You will be accountable for the figures and deadlines in your product area, while having experienced colleagues around you to spar with – and room to grow towards a Buyer role as your responsibilities expand.

Your responsibilities

As Junior Buyer, you will own a product group and a selected part of our supplier base. This means that you:

• 
Are responsible for your product group’s buying budget, target margins and buying quantities – and for getting the right products delivered on time and to the agreed quality.

• 
Lead the day-to-day dialogue and price negotiations with your suppliers, and follow up on their performance on quality, delivery precision and compliance.

• 
Represent the buying team in collection meetings and contribute data-driven recommendations on assortment, depth and pricing.

• 
Make sure your products meet our requirements for responsible production, certifications and product safety.

Your responsibilities will grow with your experience – for example with additional product groups, new suppliers or cross-functional projects in Supply Chain.

What you will work with

Suppliers & negotiation

• 
Negotiate prices, terms, MOQs and lead times with your suppliers, and prepare each negotiation with clear data and targets.

• 
Follow up on supplier performance – delivery precision, quality and responsiveness – and handle claims and corrective actions.

• 
Help develop our supplier base, including evaluating new suppliers and materials together with the team.

• 
Make sure certificates (e.g. GOTS and GRS), test reports and product safety documentation are in place for your products.

Collection & orders

• 
Take part in collection meetings from line planning to final range, working closely with Design and Sales on assortment and priorities.

• 
Place and manage purchase orders, making sure quantities, prices and master data are correct in our systems.

• 
Follow your orders through production and shipment in close cooperation with Logistics, and react quickly to delays or changes.

• 
Drive the sample flow and seasonal timeline for your product group, and make sure deadlines are met across teams.

About you

You are commercially minded and enjoy combining numbers, products and people. You take ownership of your area, keep track of the details without losing the big picture, and want a real say in what ends up in the collection. We imagine that you:

• 
Have 1–3 years of experience in buying, merchandising, sourcing or product development – ideally within fashion, footwear or lifestyle.

• 
Hold a relevant education, e.g. Design Technology (Fashion Management), a Bachelor in Design & Business, a Bachelor in International Sales & Marketing, or similar.

• 
Are analytical and confident with numbers, Excel, costings and margin calculations. Experience with an ERP or PLM system is a plus.

• 
Have hands-on experience with supplier dialogue and are comfortable leading price negotiations.

• 
Work in a structured way and take responsibility for your results from start to finish.

• 
Communicate clearly and confidently in English, both written and spoken. Danish is a plus, but not a requirement.

• 
Can prioritise between several tasks and deadlines at once, and keep a cool head when plans change.

• 
Are interested in products, fashion and responsible production – knowledge of certifications or product safety requirements is a plus.

• 
We care more about your drive, commercial sense and willingness to learn than about ticking every box.

What we offer

• 
Real ownership of a product group and its suppliers at a growing international brand

• 
A clear path towards a Buyer role as your responsibilities and results develop

• 
Sparring and support from experienced colleagues in Buying & Supply Chain

• 
Insight into the full value chain – from design and sourcing to sales and delivery

• 
A warm and collaborative work environment where well-being, trust and professional development are priorities

• 
Competitive salary and employment terms that match the role and your experience

At Wheat, we believe great work happens when people feel safe, valued and supported. We aim to create an inspiring workplace where professionalism and kindness go hand in hand.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you are excited about the role but don’t meet every single qualification, we still encourage you to apply.

The position is full-time and permanent. We hope to welcome our new Junior Buyer as soon as possible.

If you are interested, please send your application and CV in English or Danish to job@wheat.dk, marked “Junior Buyer”.

We review applications and hold interviews on an ongoing basis until the right candidate has been found — so don’t wait to apply.

Do you have experience configuring, testing and commissioning control systems for high-voltage substations? Would you like to apply your expertise to projects supporting Denmark’s electricity transmission grid? Join COWI as a Substation Control and Automation Specialist.

Develop and commission substation control systems

We are looking for an experienced specialist to work on control and automation systems for Energinet’s 132–400 kV substations. Projects range from new substations to extensions, refurbishment and replacement of systems at existing sites.

You will design, configure, test and commission substation control systems, including remote terminal units (RTUs), bay control units (BCUs) and human–machine interfaces (HMIs). Working closely with other specialists, you will ensure that these systems operate correctly and integrate with the substation’s primary equipment, protection systems and communication infrastructure.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Design and configure substation control and monitoring functions in accordance with functional requirements and customer specifications.

• Configure, test and commission RTUs, bay control units and HMIs.

• Configure and verify communication interfaces between control devices, protection equipment and remote control systems.

• Plan and perform functional and integration testing to verify control functions, signal exchange and correct operation of system interfaces.

• Troubleshoot configuration, communication and interface issues in collaboration with other technical specialists.

• Prepare and maintain configuration documentation, test procedures and test records.

• Coordinate technical interfaces with colleagues responsible for protection, communication systems, electrical design and primary equipment

• Undertake the designated on-site role of “holdleder” when required and subject to the relevant qualifications and authorisation.

Your expertise

You take a systematic approach to configuration, testing and troubleshooting. You work independently, pay close attention to technical detail and collaborate effectively with colleagues, customers and suppliers. You understand how individual devices and interfaces contribute to the operation of the complete substation control system.

You will also bring:

• A relevant qualification in electrical engineering or an equivalent technical background, combined with at least five years of relevant experience with control systems for high-voltage substations.

• Demonstrated experience configuring and testing substation control equipment from multiple manufacturers.

• Practical experience with IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 60870-5-103 and IEC 61850 communication protocols and standards.

• A sound understanding of the interfaces between substation control systems, protection equipment and high-voltage primary equipment.

• Experience with functional testing, system integration and commissioning of substation control systems.

• Professional proficiency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

• The ability to obtain the required security clearance and meet the qualification and authorisation requirements for acting as “holdleder” at high-voltage substations.

Your place of work

Depending on project requirements, you may work from one of COWI’s offices in Denmark, at Energinet project locations or partly from home. Testing and commissioning activities will require attendance at the relevant project sites. Travel within Denmark is expected.

A place to work and so much more

At COW, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Head of Discipline Carsten Sass Husum at CSHU@COWI.COM.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Equal opportunity employer

COWI provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, COWI complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

jobs.occupation: Student Worker, Vendor Management, Global Drug Safety & Pharmacovigilance
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Student Assistant to join our team. In this role, you will support a wide range of operational and financial activities that are essential to our day-to-day business. You will work closely with colleagues across Finance, Procurement, and external vendors, gaining valuable insight into financial processes and stakeholder management within an international organization.

This is an excellent opportunity for a student who enjoys working with data, optimizing processes, and collaborating with multiple stakeholders while developing practical experience alongside their studies.

As a Student Assistant, you will become part of a collaborative and supportive team where you will gain hands-on experience with financial operations, procurement processes, vendor management, and business analytics. You will have the opportunity to build practical skills, work with experienced professionals, and contribute meaningfully to the team's success while continuing your studies at our HQ office in Valby.

**Key Responsibilities

**As our Student Assistant, your responsibilities will include:

• Review and approval of vendor invoices in accordance with internal procedures

• Communicate with external vendors and the Accounts Payable team regarding invoicing and payment-related matters

• Coordinate with the Procurement team on Purchase Requisition and Purchase Order activities

• Assist in monitoring departmental spend and help maintain department financial overviews and accruals

• Maintain and update financial data to support dashboards, reporting, and data visualization

• Support access management processes, including maintaining access records and tracking user permissions

• Prepare, write, and distribute meeting minutes and follow up on agreed action items

• Assist with a variety of ad hoc administrative, operational, and analytical tasks as needed

**Requirments

**You Are Currently In The Final Year Of Your Bachelor's Degree And Intend To Continue Your Studies At The Master's Level. Relevant Fields Of Study Include

• Business Administration

• Economics

• Business Economics

• Finance

• Accounting

• Or a similar business-related discipline

**Moreover, You Are Someone Who Is

**

• Proactive and eager to take initiative

• Curious by nature and motivated to learn new systems and processes

• Outgoing and comfortable communicating with colleagues across different functions

• Structured, organized, and attentive to detail

• Able to work independently while also enjoying being part of a collaborative team

• Comfortable working with numbers and data and interested in financial and operational processes

• Experience with or strong interest in AI, automation, etc. will be considered an advantage

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel; experience with Power BI or similar visualization tools is an advantage but not a requirement

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK180,00---180,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

**Your impact begins here

**As Student Assistant in the Legal, Compliance & Quality team, you will support colleagues across Novo Denmark on a broad range of legal and compliance activities. You will work on contract drafting and review, legal research, data privacy and AI governance questions, and various ad hoc projects, while learning how law works in a life sciences company. Your work helps colleagues move forward with confidence and contributes to Novo’s purpose of driving change for people living with serious chronic diseases.

**What You’ll Bring

**You are a proactive and curious law student who enjoys taking responsibility and being a reliable partner to the people you support. We expect you to bring:

• Current enrolment in a Bachelor’s or Master’s programme within Law.

• Fluent written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English.

• A structured, organised and detail-oriented way of working.

• A proactive, reliable and service-minded approach.

• Confidence using digital tools and systems.

• Curiosity about pharma and the legal challenges within life sciences.

**What You’ll Do

**You will support the team with a broad range of legal and compliance tasks, taking ownership of day-to-day work while learning from experienced colleagues. Your work will include:

• Support the drafting and review of contracts and templates.

• Carry out legal research and share clear findings with the team.

• Help answer data privacy questions and contribute to AI governance matters.

• Support colleagues with day-to-day legal and compliance questions.

• Provide stakeholder support and follow up on your assigned tasks.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Legal, Compliance & Quality team in Novo Denmark where you will report to the Director Legal, Compliance & Quality, Christian Bennet Rosenbæk.

The Legal, Compliance & Quality team acts as a trusted partner to the business, supporting a broad range of activities across Marketing, Commercial Excellence, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Public Affairs, and other functions.

The role is office-based in Ørestad, Copenhagen, however, we recognise the importance of balancing work and academics and strive to provide additional flexibility during exam periods whenever possible.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will be trusted to take ownership of your tasks and supported to perform at your best. You will get hands-on experience with legal and compliance topics in a life sciences setting, learn from colleagues who work with them every day, and be encouraged to make your voice heard.

Salary and Benefits: This position is hourly paid, and the position is approximately 15 hours per week. For this position, the hourly base rate is 209,27 DKK based on an assessment of relevant factors such as experience, educational background, demonstrated competencies, and the specific skills required for the position. In addition to the hourly base rate, Student Assistants are entitled to a pension scheme (currently 10% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution).

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to build practical legal and compliance experience and support colleagues across Novo Denmark, apply for the Student Assistant Legal & Compliance role by 18 November 2026.

For further information, please contact Anna Aagaard Saks (zaaa@novonordisk.com) or Sigrid Duus (sgdf@novonordisk.com) from the Legal, Compliance & Quality team.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager within Process Automation at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
Does the idea of being part of the largest pharmaceutical projects in Denmark and managing complex Process Automation projects excite you? And do you thrive on defining and executing project strategies in close corporation with highly skilled colleagues? Then you’ll fit right in!

**Who We Are

**We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

**About The Role

**As a Senior Project Manager within Process Automation, you will be part of our large project portfolio in Kalundborg. You will play an important role in ensuring the successful execution of our deliveries and will be in close contact with both internal and external stakeholders.

As part of your role, you will maintain close dialogue with your team on-site and participate in regular meetings across disciplines, ensuring transparency, efficiency, and execution according to our plans.

The technical focus of this position is Process Automation, working with DCS 800xA and ECS solutions interfacing with new technologies within the Industry 4.0 domain and Manufacturing IT solutions. Our projects cover the entire project lifecycle, from conceptual and basic design phases to on-site testing activities, including FAT, Interface Testing, Wet Testing, SAT, and UAT, culminating in handover to our customers.

Based on your skills and experience, several opportunities are available within our portfolio.

Location Denmark - Kalundborg

Experience Minimum 5 Years

Department AIT Project Management

**How You Might Spend Your Days

**As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for:

• Executing projects within your area in close collaboration with your team, identifying risks and implementing mitigation measures.

• Focusing on overall project planning, ensuring delivery quality, and planning the necessary resources to maintain schedule and cost targets.

• Estimating costs and planning budgets in collaboration with our engineers and specialists.

• Managing project scope and ensuring that changes are analysed and agreed upon with stakeholders.

**Who You Are

**We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you:

• Work across the boundaries and you like to work in a diverse and international environment

• Create results through efficient project management and communication, leveraging from your relations to your team and stakeholder

• Have a personal commitment, known for your effectiveness and an open management style and know the impotency to win as a team

• Are fluent in English both written and spoken

**What You Bring To The Role

Senior Product Manager, Scientific Software — Copenhagen

The company

Our client is a venture-backed Copenhagen biotech that designs a new class of oral drugs. It uses its own generative AI, automated chemistry and high-throughput biology. The platform has made and tested hundreds of thousands of novel compounds, and the company has a major pharma partnership behind it. R&D is organised under a CTO across three groups: AI & Computational Drug Design, Platform Chemistry, and Screening Biology.

The role

The Senior Product Manager will own the company's internal scientific software, so every team works from the same clean, consistent data with tools that fit together.

The company creates, moves and decides on large volumes of chemistry and biology data. Today each team builds its own solutions. The company is moving to a new data platform built for its molecules and will build custom internal products on top of it.

The Product Manager is the person who sees that three teams are building three versions of the same thing and turns them into one that works for everyone. Success is measured in time saved for the scientists: the software should save more than it costs.

Responsibilities

Product ownership

• Owns the roadmap for the internal scientific software, starting with the three products above.

• Gathers and challenges requirements from computational design, chemistry and biology, and turns parallel requests into shared solutions.

• Prioritises with the leadership team: what gets built, in what order, and why.

• Makes sure the products connect to each other and to the data platform.

• Runs user testing and adoption with the scientists, and tracks the time saved.

Delivery and leadership

• Works agile, and knows where agility stops. Ships working products within months without painting the platform into a corner.

• Leads and coordinates 3–6 developers, a mix of contractors and hires. A front-end engineer may report directly.

• Helps shape the software team as it grows.

Hands-on, at the start

• Contributes to the build until the development team is in place. The stack is Python on the back end, React/Redux on the front end, and AWS serverless services.

• Judges which components fit together and which will break, including AI-assisted code.

The profile

The ideal candidate has experience from an environment where software is built and shipped, and a scientific background. Beyond that, in order of importance:

• People leadership. Has led developers or cross-functional teams, internal or contracted, and aligned stakeholders who don't report to them.

• Product management track record. Has owned a software product or platform from idea to adoption.

• Drug discovery experience. Has worked close to design, synthesis, screening or compound selection. Broader R&D software is also relevant.

• Scientific background. A chemistry or biology degree (either is fine). Knows what they don't know, and asks.

• Hands-on coding. Can build in Python and React. Judgement matters more than depth.

Mindset: curious enough to ask "what's a canonical SMILES?", pragmatic about agile, and happy to start hands-on and grow into leading a team.

Nice to have: AWS serverless, lab automation or screening data, ELN/LIMS or compound registration, startup or scale-up experience. The working language is English.

Set-up, package and process

• Reporting. To the VP of AI & Computational Drug Design, with a weekly 1:1 and short daily stand-ups.

• Location. On site in Copenhagen, enough to work alongside the chemists and biologists in the lab. There is no fixed number of days.

• Career path. Starts senior and hands-on, and grows into leading a dedicated software team.

• Package. A competitive salary, pension, a performance bonus, and participation in the company's warrant programme.

• Process. A short screening call, then an online session where the candidate presents software they have built, then on-site interviews. The target start is early 2027.

With an IoT platform connecting more millions of devices, and growing - Trackunit is building the connectivity layer underneath the construction industry. Every one of those units carries a cellular radio, and every one of those radios sits inside a web of standards, type approvals, and patent licences that decides whether we can ship and where we can ship.

You will join our IoT Division, Device Reliability Engineering (DRE) team as an expert on IoT certifications, standards, and licensing including Standard Essential Patents (SEP). This position shapes both our exposure and our coverage arguments, and it means this role works in every direction at once, with suppliers, regulatory approvals, legal advisors, product and engineering, and with customers.

This is a role for someone who can hold a genuinely complex domain in their head and then explain it in three sentences to a customer who has never heard the phrase “patent exhaustion.”

Experience level: a deep specialist role. We expect solid, hands-on experience with cellular device approvals and licensing — likely 10+ years across regulatory, certification, or IP/licensing work in mobile, IoT, or telecom hardware. This is a senior individual contributor position with no direct reports, high autonomy, and direct executive visibility.

With locations in the heart of Copenhagen, Kolding, Aarhus, and Aalborg, we offer a flexible setup with the possibility to work from one of our locations — or remotely from anywhere in Denmark.

****What's in it for you?

• A domain you will own, not administer. IoT Cellular License, SEP and certification strategy is an executive-level topic at Trackunit right now, with real financial exposure attached. You will not be filing paperwork in a corner, you will be shaping the position the company takes.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching, and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. We offer a flexible setup because we believe you know best how to structure your work. Once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. And this priority starts with our hiring — we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives here.

****What you'll do

****Your work splits roughly into four parts: licensing, approvals, guidance, and governance.

• Own our SEP position. Understand where our cellular SEP exposure actually sits across our device portfolio, track the relevant patent pools and licensing programmes, and maintain a clear, evidence-based view of what is covered through our supply chain and what is not.

• Run supplier licensing due diligence. Establish and maintain a consistent set of asks across module suppliers — coverage confirmation, standards and generations covered, and honest disclosure of known gaps — so responses can be compared side by side and fed into supplier qualification.

• Support licensing negotiations and claims. Work alongside our General Counsel, external patent counsel, and economic advisors on royalty basis questions, valuation and apportionment arguments, and claims that reach us through our OEM customers. You bring the technical and supply chain substance; they bring the legal strategy.

• Own global type approvals and certification. Plan and steer RED/CE, FCC, ISED, UKCA, and the wider set of regional approvals, plus GCF/PTCRB and carrier certification, across a multi-region device portfolio. Keep certification on the critical path of new product programmes rather than at the end of them.

• Stay ahead of regulatory change. Cyber Resilience Act, RED delegated acts, radio spectrum and network sunsets, environmental and product compliance requirements — know what is coming, when it bites, and what it means for our roadmap.

• Make the complex simple, and guide without over-promising. Write and maintain the internal playbooks, customer-facing explainers, and OEM guidance that turn this domain into something a commercial colleague or a customer can act on. Be the person Sales, Legal, and customers come to when a licensing notification lands, explaining the landscape accurately, saying clearly where the limits of our position are, and pointing customers to independent specialist advice where that is the right answer.

• Build the governance. Response protocols, decision records, escalation paths, and embedding licensing and compliance requirements into how we qualify suppliers and run the product development lifecycle.

****Who you are

****We think you'll need

• Strong working knowledge of cellular connectivity (e.g. LTE-M, NB-IoT, LTE Cat-1/1bis, 5G) and the direction of travel, plus a real understanding of the module and chipset landscape.

• Solid, practical experience with licensing and Standard Essential Patents in mobile or IoT devices: FRAND principles, patent pools, patent exhaustion and the limits of sublicensing, and how royalties are actually structured and argued.

• Hands-on experience with global type approvals and regulatory certification for radio products — RED/CE, FCC, and the regional approvals that come with selling hardware worldwide.

• Experience working across a hardware supply chain with module suppliers, test houses, notified bodies, and certification partners.

• Communication as a core skill, not a bonus. You can take a genuinely complicated subject and land it in plain language, in writing, with an audience that has no background in it.

• The judgement to know what we can and cannot say to a customer, and the discipline to hold that line even when it would be easier not to.

**What Matters More Than The Checklist

**

• You are honest about uncertainty. In this domain, no one can offer a blanket guarantee, and the people who claim otherwise create problems later. We would rather be accurate than reassuring.

• You are curious and self-driven, this is a field that changes constantly, and nobody is going to hand you a reading list.

• You finish things. A clear one-page answer delivered this week beats a perfect analysis that arrives after the decision was made.

• You are comfortable being the only person in the room who knows a subject, and you use that position to make others smarter rather than to make yourself indispensable.

On AI: experience with AI tooling is not a requirement, but a strong motivation and interest in working with it is. We already use AI in our daily engineering work, including MCP servers and agents against our own platform, and we see clear potential in applying it to research, documentation, and compliance workflows. We don't expect you to have experience with this but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to learn.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're excited about this role and your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we still encourage you to apply.

****How you'll grow here

****This is a specialist role with an unusually wide view of the business, and we've set it up that way on purpose.

• Executive proximity. You will work closely with the SVP of IoT Division, while reporting into a central function for IoT, as the Device Reliability Engineering. You will help in presenting to executive leadership on exposure, risk, and recommendations. Your analysis will inform on a product technical matter (Not Legal) but with real financial and commercial decisions.

• Cross-functional reach. Legal, Finance, Product Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Sales all depend on this domain. Few roles at Trackunit touch as many parts of the company.

• External network. You will work with external patent counsel, economic consultants, module suppliers, certification bodies, and industry forums — building a network that extends well beyond Trackunit.

• Room to define the function. This discipline is being built out now. What it becomes — and whether it grows into a team — is substantially yours to shape.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We're committed to construction one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products — it's a way of life at Trackunit. We're proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

**Your impact begins here

**Build and improve the applications that support colleagues across Novo Nordisk’s SAP Supply Chain area. You will work across the full stack, from user interfaces and APIs to cloud deployment and production support, in a team that values reliable software and practical engineering.

**What You’ll Bring

**We are looking for a well-rounded developer who enjoys working across frontend, backend, cloud and delivery practices. You bring:

• 2+ years of relevant software development experience, with hands-on TypeScript experience across frontend and backend development.

• Experience building cloud applications, services or APIs, and an interest in developing your skills on SAP BTP.

• Practical experience with Git, CI/CD and DevOps ways of working, including automated testing and code review.

• An ability to investigate problems, write maintainable code and work collaboratively with people in different roles.

• Strong communication skills and an interest in understanding business processes, so you can clarify needs with stakeholders and translate them into practical technical solutions.

• A compliance mindset: you understand why changes, tests, access and releases need to be controlled and traceable.

• An interest in using AI tools in your daily development work to support coding, testing and problem-solving, while applying critical judgement and taking responsibility for the quality of your work.

• Strong written and spoken English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**Experience with SAP BTP, Node.js, SAP Cloud Application Programming Model, SAPUI5/Fiori, GitHub or enterprise integrations would be useful. GxP experience is an advantage, but it is not required; we will support you in learning the applicable processes and standards.

**What You’ll Do

**You will help develop and operate applications on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP). Working with product owners, engineers, architects and business specialists, you will turn needs into secure, maintainable solutions. You will contribute hands-on across the software lifecycle and grow your knowledge of our platforms and business processes along the way.

**Day To Day, You Will

**

• Build and maintain full-stack applications using TypeScript, including user interfaces, backend services and APIs.

• Design, test and troubleshoot cloud applications and integrations across our enterprise landscape.

• Use Git, code reviews and pipelines to build, test and release changes reliably.

• Support applications in production by investigating issues, using logs and monitoring, and improving the services you work on.

• Write clear technical documentation and apply appropriate testing, security and release controls.

• Work with teammates and stakeholders to improve existing applications, reduce technical debt and share useful engineering practices.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join SAP Quality Solutions within SAP & Ecosystems in Enterprise IT. We support Manufacturing Quality and Supply Chain processes through enterprise platforms, integrations and a portfolio of BTP applications. Product ownership, architecture, engineering and system management work closely together, giving you the opportunity to understand both the technology and the people who rely on it.

**What You Can Expect Here

**The applications you build and support help colleagues across Novo Nordisk do their work. You will have room to develop your technical skills, learn the business context and contribute ideas for making our services more reliable and easier to use. We value curiosity, sound judgement, collaboration and a willingness to learn.

**What We Offer

**At Novo Nordisk, you'll join a global healthcare company with a distinct culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 570,200.00 to 838,100.00DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to build reliable applications that keep quality and supply chain work moving, apply for the Full-Stack Cloud Developer role by November 15th 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Student Assistant in Information Security at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
If you’re energized by learning how organizations protect their people and data, and you thrive on turning theory into practice alongside experienced security colleagues, we’d love to hear from you!

**Who We Are

**We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

**About The Role

**We are looking for a Student Assistant to join our Information Security team in Global IT.

As a team, we are working on keeping NNE’s users, devices and data secure - from identity and access management to governance, risk and compliance (GRC). Your contribution will be important in supporting our security consultants in their daily work and improvement initiatives, while you gain practical experience alongside your studies.

Your place of work will be at our Headquarter in Virum and the position is 15–20 hours a week..

Location Denmark - Virum

Experience Graduate level

Department Information Security

**How You Might Spend Your Days

**As a Student Assistant you’ll be:

• Supporting the team with day-to-day security tasks, such as reviewing user access and handling security requests

• Helping to keep our security documentation, policies and procedures up to date

• Contributing to governance, risk and compliance (GRC) work, for example security risk assessments

• Helping with security awareness activities, such as phishing awareness for colleagues

• Taking part in security projects and learning Microsoft security tools such as Entra ID, Defender and Intune along the way

**Who You Are

**We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Curious about information security and eager to learn

• Proactive and comfortable asking questions and taking the initiative

• Reliable and structured, with a good balance between your studies and your work

• Open to sharing your ideas and to giving and receiving feedback

• Comfortable working with colleagues across teams, disciplines and cultures

**What You Bring To The Role

**In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• You are studying for a master’s degree in IT, computer science, cybersecurity or a related field – bachelor’s students are also welcome to apply

• You have a basic understanding of security principles, such as identities, access management and incident handling

• You have an interest in or basic knowledge of governance, risk and compliance (GRC)

• You can work 15–20 hours a week alongside your studies

• You are available for 12 months+

**Why choose NNE?

**NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer **here .

****Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

****Deadline of application is 15th November 2026

**Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Anton Rockler at +45 31 91 12 43.

**Please note:

**

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

• As part of our recruitment process for this position, we may request a background check at a later stage. This is only done when relevant to the responsibilities of the role. If required, you will be informed about the purpose, how your data will be processed, and asked for your consent before we proceed.

**Fair hiring:

**At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

**Still searching for the right opportunity?

**If this position isn’t quite what you're looking for, but you know someone who would excel in this role, please share this job post. And don’t forget to explore our other exciting opportunities — your future role at NNE might be just around the corner! Visit our Career Site

OJ Electronics – a Danish producer of HVAC drives, AHU controllers, and thermostats for electric floor heating – is hiring a QA and validation engineer to join our cross-departmental QA & Product Compliance team.

For this position, we will be interviewing on an ongoing basis until we find the right person.

Founded in 1964 and headquartered in Sønderborg, Denmark, OJ Electronics produces HVAC drives, AHU controllers, and underfloor heating thermostats. You will be part of an engaged and informal team who values skill and knowledge creation.

**The position

**ALK is looking for a strategic and experienced Director, Finance Digital Transformation, to lead the contribution from Finance’s to the SAP S/4HANA transformation and drive the continuous development of ALK’s Finance application landscape.

In this role, you will ensure that finance requirements, controls, data integrity, and reporting needs are embedded in the future ERP landscape. You will also lead the roadmap for SAP, BW/BI, AI, and automation initiatives while building a centre of excellence for finance applications and projects.

As the primary interface between Finance, Global Business IT (GBIT), and external implementation partners, you will play a key role in shaping how technology enables Finance across ALK.

**

• Develop and maintain Finance’s application and technology strategy in cooperation with the Global Finance Board.

**

• At least 8 years of experience in finance systems, finance IT, or related roles.

• Hands-on experience with SAP finance modules; experience with SAP S/4HANA is strongly preferred.

• Experience leading or playing a senior role in a major ERP transformation.

• Knowledge of BW/BI platforms and finance reporting or planning solutions.

• Experience with AI, automation, or advanced analytics in a finance context is an advantage.

• Proven people leadership experience, preferably managing a team of specialists.

• Strong project and programme management skills; relevant certification such as PMP or PRINCE2 is an advantage.

• Strong understanding of finance systems integration, governance, controls, and data management.

• Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, communication, and negotiation skills.

• Structured, analytical, and process-oriented approach with a strong focus on continuous improvement.

• Fluent written and spoken English.

Our flat structures attract independent individuals who like to feel the progress of the business and enjoy being close to the decision-making process. We consider our pioneering spirit, coupled with our trustworthiness, our winning formula.
